references.text: Israel settled in the land of the Amorites, confirming the conquest mentioned in verse 25
Heshbon is listed among the cities Israel conquered and later gave to the tribes of Reuben and Gad
Moses recounts how God gave Sihon and his land to Israel, including Heshbon
Sihon, king of Heshbon, refused Israel passage, leading to their conquest
Sihon, the Amorite king who lived in Heshbon, is mentioned among the kings Israel defeated
Heshbon and all its towns are noted as part of Sihon's kingdom that Israel conquered
Jephthah refers to Israel's settlement in Heshbon and its villages for 300 years
Nehemiah mentions the conquest of Sihon's land, the king of Heshbon
The psalm praises God for defeating Sihon, the Amorite king
A song of praise recalling the victory over Sihon, the Amorite king
